events.title: Huntsville Havoc vs. Pensacola Ice Flyers
events.venue: Propst Arena at the Von Braun Center
events.blurb: SPHL hockey on Black Friday, with merchandise deals at the game. Doors open 90 minutes early; clear bags only.
events.blurbEs: Hockey de la SPHL el Black Friday, con ofertas en mercancía durante el partido. Las puertas abren 90 minutos antes; solo se permiten bolsas transparentes.

events.title: Mustache the Band
events.venue: Mars Music Hall at the Von Braun Center
events.blurb: The '70s and '80s hits cover band plays Mars Music Hall. Doors open an hour before the show.
events.blurbEs: La banda de covers de éxitos de los 70 y 80 toca en Mars Music Hall. Las puertas abren una hora antes del show.

events.title: Galaxy of Lights
events.addr: 4747 Bob Wallace Ave SW, Huntsville, AL 35805
events.blurb: The garden's holiday light show on a walking night, with timed-entry tickets from 4:30 to 8:45 p.m. Saturday and Sunday open with a 4:30 p.m. sensory hour with reduced music.
events.blurbEs: El espectáculo navideño de luces del jardín en noche para caminar, con boletos de entrada programada de 4:30 a 8:45 p.m. El sábado y el domingo abren con una hora sensorial a las 4:30 p.m. con música reducida.
events.getThere: On walking nights, guests enter through the Propst Guest Center.

events.title: Small Business Saturday at Lowe Mill
events.blurb: Shop handmade gifts from the artists in the old mill's studios, with skill demos, a Christmas boutique and a free drop-in cigar box guitar lesson at noon.
events.blurbEs: Compra regalos hechos a mano a los artistas en los estudios de la antigua fábrica, con demostraciones, una boutique navideña y una clase gratis de guitarra de caja de puros al mediodía.

events.title: Freaksgiving 2.0
events.blurb: A free alternative makers' market by day, then a night of bingo, comedy, music and camp performance benefiting Shenanigans Comedy Theatre.
events.blurbEs: Un mercado alternativo gratis de día y, por la noche, bingo, comedia, música y espectáculos camp a beneficio de Shenanigans Comedy Theatre.

events.title: U.S. Space & Rocket Center
events.blurb: Rockets, the Saturn V hall and space history exhibits; open 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. all weekend. Kids 4 and under get in free.
events.blurbEs: Cohetes, la sala del Saturn V y exhibiciones de historia espacial; abierto de 10 a.m. a 4 p.m. todo el fin de semana. Los niños de 4 años o menos entran gratis.

events.title: Big Spring Park
events.blurb: Downtown's park around the spring where Huntsville began, next to the Von Braun Center.
events.blurbEs: El parque del centro alrededor del manantial donde nació Huntsville, junto al Von Braun Center.
